📖 How to use

  1. Set your challenge name and start date (optional).
  2. Click cells to check off completed days.
  3. Watch your completion %, current streak and longest streak update.
  4. Use Reset Challenge to start over.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I check off a day?

Click any cell to toggle it checked (done) or unchecked. The grid fills in order but you can toggle any day.

What is the longest streak stat?

The longest streak is your longest run of consecutive checked days, in grid order.

Is my progress saved?

Yes — your checks are stored in localStorage in this browser.

How do I start over?

Click Reset Challenge to clear all 100 cells and start over (with confirmation).
